job.title: Ascendion - Data Engineer - Google Cloud Platform

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience engineering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Framework, RESTful OCC web services, and microservices architecture. Proven delivery of robust data pipelines and integrations connecting PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Experienced in CCv2 cloud deployments, Solr search, database query optimization, and agile delivery across international software engineering teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Software Engineering
cover_en.hook: Ascendion's reputation for high-impact software engineering and digital enterprise innovation makes this SAP Commerce Cloud Developer opening an outstanding match for my technical background. I bring over 5 years of hands-on experience engineering, extending, and supporting large enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend and headless functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, managing catalog, product, pricing, and OMS data structures.

bullets.label: RESTful OCC APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for headless storefront consumers while building robust PIM, ERP, and MDM data pipelines via DataHub and Hotfolders.

bullets.label: Performance & Data Tuning
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and Solr indexing optimizations that significantly reduced latency and improved transaction speed under high enterprise loads.

bullets.label: DevOps & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), managing production troubleshooting and code reviews within agile international teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required). Currently serving my notice period with Rockwell Automation (last working day 15 December 2026), I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce expertise fits your engineering goals.

tailoring.why_company: Ascendion combines world-class software engineering with applied digital innovation, delivering enterprise-scale platforms that drive measurable client impact. With my background executing complex SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, headless OCC APIs, and enterprise data integrations, I am eager to contribute robust backend engineering to Ascendion's high-performing delivery teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years building scalable SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) backends for global enterprises, I am eager to bring my Java, Spring, OCC API, and integration expertise to Ascendion's engineering team to deliver resilient, high-performance digital commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I noticed Ascendion's opening for an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer. With 5+ years engineering SAP Hybris platforms (2105/2211), Java/Spring backends, and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would value connecting to discuss your team's goals.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position at Ascendion. With over five years of dedicated experience developing enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) solutions, Java/Spring backends, and OCC REST APIs for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your engineering delivery.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
